"Castle Clean" is a term used in Chess to indicate it is clear to make a move called a "Castle". This is where you leapfrog the King and a rook provided the following applies;- neither piece has been moved prior, you're not moving through check or into check and there are no pieces standing in between.

Also in Chess the Queen always starts on her own color, the King on opposite color. Assuming the white hats are white, the King will be on a black square and arrive on a white one when the move is complete. Dark to Light.

In the latest illustration POTUS represents the King and the two Marines the rooks at each end. Castle clean means "I'm not in check,not moving through or into check, there are no pieces in my way, so I'm now safe to move from dark to light and bring my [rooks] into play."
